speaker: (first_student)
text: We brought a pottle, because the play is done and a story goes better with wine than without.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Come as far as the door, masters, and pour it. The last time we saw your hall, a man could not lift his elbow.

speaker: (second_student)
text: The hall was so thronged the dancing was ruined before any of you were thought of. The Templars' ambassador left in dudgeon.

speaker: (first_student)
text: And then a company of base and common fellows was brought in, to crown the confusion with a play.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Base and common. I will have that in writing, if either of you has a scrap. It is the best notice I have had this Christmas.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You may keep the sentence, Kemp. They came with wine, not with a commission to write it on a wall.

speaker: (second_student)
text: We have the sentence, and you may keep it. Afterwards the Inn held a mock trial and blamed a sorcerer.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Let me have been the sorcerer. I am free that night, whichever night the book prefers. You have my offer. I will not charge you for it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The book prefers a night, and it is particular. Greenwich in the afternoon, and Gray's Inn that night. I have it so written.

speaker: will_kemp
text: It was the night before. I have sworn that once, and I swear it again. Your book was written with cold fingers. The swearing does not make the book true.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I remember the cold on the river. I do not remember two houses as two dates. Cold is what I have. You may not borrow it.

speaker: (first_student)
text: Two houses in one night. A clerk hereafter will make two companies of you, like the twins in your play.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Let him. Any clerk hereafter may have two houses in one night, and sleep better than we did. I will drink to the clerk that reconciles them, and I will not help him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not the book, and I am not the oath. I was not in the hall. This parlour door is as far as the story gets tonight.

speaker: (second_student)
text: We did not come to have it decided. The ambassador left. The dancing failed. The fellows played. The sorcerer was blamed.

speaker: (first_student)
text: We saw the Prince ride past St Helen's on Saturday, to dine with the Mayor. He kept a better seat than we kept on our benches.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The Mayor will feast a mock-prince and shut the door on a player. I heard that on Saturday, and I am still pleased to be base and common. Drink, before John charges you for the candle.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The wine is theirs. I charge no man for his own sack. And I am not lending the book to a parlour.

speaker: (second_student)
text: Good night, masters. The wine was the manners. The story was the debt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night. Give your Prince joy of his kingdom till Candlemas. I am not coming into the hall to improve the tale.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: What of Saturday? Do I hear the fifth act after the reckoning, or must I send for it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: At the Jackdaw, after the boxes are counted. I wrote the messenger in last night. Thou shalt hear it as far as it goes, and it does not go to the end.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Set it down, so thou forgettest not. I have not heard it. I will not pretend I have.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Go and be mysterious up the lane on Saturday. Tonight I am base and common, and I have asked for it in writing, and I have offered to be the sorcerer.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The book stays as I wrote it. Greenwich in the afternoon, and Gray's Inn that night. You may swear against it on the way home. I will not unwrite it here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am taking none of the three home as a verdict. Dick has Saturday. John has the book. Kemp has the compliment. I have a walk.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then walk. Thou hast promised the Jackdaw. I shall be there, and I shall be hungry, and I shall not have been in the hall either.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Base and common fellows. I have it in the ear if not on a scrap, and I will not let the door take it with them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then good night at the door. I have the book. They have the wine. Neither of us is rewriting December in a parlour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night. Saturday is the Jackdaw, and tonight is not the hall.
